chapter: The Dallas nightclub and Jesse Stone's band
title: Southern Serenaders become Walter Page's Blue Devils
summary: Budd clarifies that the Southern Serenaders of 1927 became Walter Page's Blue Devils and later Basie's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: By this time this band that I was talking about, called the Southern Serenaders, had finally become Walter Paige's
The Southern Serenaders -- was the Blue Serenaders.
Now that's -- but the Southern Serenaders was back up in here like around '27, when I got stranded in Oklahoma City, and we played the concert for her --
Oh, it was the Southern Serenaders there.
Yeah, and they finally became the Blue Devils under the tutelage of Walter Paige, which later became Count Basie. See?
